entities.summary: Charles Allieu Matthew Campbell is a Sierra Leonian Roman Catholic prelate who is the bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Bo in Sierra Leone since January 2011. He was appointed bishop on 15 January 2011 by Pope Benedict XVI. He was consecrated and installed at Bo, Sierra Leone on 7 May 2011. He previously served a priest of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Freetown.
